evidence.original_label: SPRUCE-600 最小灵敏度（公司 中科飞测）
evidence.excerpt: 公司 中科飞测 科磊半导体 ¦ 设备型号 SPRUCE-600 Surfscan SP1TBI ¦ 工艺节点 130nm 或以上 130nm 或以上 ¦ 最小灵敏度 60nm 60nm ¦ 吞吐量 100wph（灵敏度 102nm） 未披露

notes: Minimum detectable defect size of the SPRUCE-600 unpatterned-wafer inspector. The filing states the throughput figure is conditional on sensitivity: 100wph is quoted at a sensitivity of 102nm, not at the 60nm minimum, so the two must not be read as simultaneous. The issuer also states that minimum sensitivity is normally 0.5 to 1 times the production process node and that its sensitivity is far smaller than the optical imaging resolution of its light source, which is why detection limit and imaging resolution are separate metrics in the atlas. The benchmark column reports the same 60nm for KLA Surfscan SP1TBI. Issuer benchmark table against a named international competitor; the 中科飞测 column is the first value column and only it is recorded as evidence about SkyVerse. The excerpt reproduces the page’s own consecutive text lines, joined with ¦ to mark each line break; the separator is editorial, because this filing lays out its benchmark and core-technology tables with labels split vertically around their value cells.

evidence.original_label: BIRCH-100 最小灵敏度（公司 中科飞测）
evidence.excerpt: 公司 中科飞测 创新科技 ¦ 设备型号 BIRCH-100 Rudolph F30 ¦ 最小灵敏度 0.5μm 0.5μm ¦ 吞吐量 80wph（灵敏度 3μm） 120wph（灵敏度 10μm） ¦ 缺陷复查模式 支持三种彩色复查模式 支持三种彩色复查模式

notes: Minimum detectable defect size of the BIRCH-100 patterned-wafer inspector, printed in micrometre and therefore three orders coarser than the SPRUCE models. This is the figure that places the BIRCH series at micron rather than nanometre scale. Held at the inspection parent rather than a child: p170 makes BIRCH-100 an upgrade model within the 图形晶圆缺陷检测设备 series that 成功进入前道市场, while this page says the model is mainly applied to advanced-packaging outgoing inspection, so both applications are stated. Throughput is conditional: 80wph at a sensitivity of 3μm, not at the 0.5μm minimum. Micrometre and nanometre are separate unit dimensions in the atlas, so this row is not directly comparable with the SPRUCE rows without an explicit conversion. Issuer benchmark table against a named international competitor; the 中科飞测 column is the first value column and only it is recorded as evidence about SkyVerse. evidence.original_label: CYPRESS-U950 重复性精度（公司 中科飞测）
evidence.excerpt: 公司 中科飞测 帕克公司 ¦ 设备型号 CYPRESS-U950 NX Wafer ¦ 重复性精度 0.1nm 0.1nm ¦ 量测方式 自动数据采集和分析 自动数据采集和分析 ¦ 通常来说该指标的数值大小需要达到客户实际制程工艺控制精度的 1/3 或 ¦ 更小，才能够支持客户实现对其产线制程工艺的精准控制。公司该型号设备的 ¦ 重复性精度达到 0.1nm，能够支持 2Xnm 及以上制程工艺中的三维形貌测量。

notes: Repeatability precision of the CYPRESS-U950 three-dimensional topography metrology tool. The filing defines the indicator explicitly as the standard deviation of repeated measurements of the same location and feature, and states that a smaller value is better, so this metric must never be ranked as though larger were better. The issuer adds that the figure normally needs to be one third or less of the customer’s process control precision, and that 0.1nm supports 2Xnm and above topography measurement. The benchmark column reports the same 0.1nm for Park Systems NX Wafer. Issuer benchmark table against a named international competitor; the 中科飞测 column is the first value column and only it is recorded as evidence about SkyVerse. evidence.original_label: 高深宽比结构的膜厚量测技术 技术先进性 深宽比大于 15:1
evidence.excerpt: 该技术结合晶圆表面的结构信 ¦ 该技术通过光学系统设计中的特有孔 ¦ 高深宽比 息和图像信息，在入射通道或 ¦ 径限制技术，在高深宽比三维电路结 ¦ 结构的膜 检 测 通道 中 通过 孔径 限制 技 ¦ 5 构中有效抑制了来自非测量区域的干 ¦ 厚量测技 术，减少高深宽比结构的噪声 ¦ 扰信号，实现了深宽比大于 15:1 的 ¦ 术 光信号干扰，实现对高深宽比 ¦ 三维结构中介质膜厚的高精度测量 ¦ 结构膜层的高精度测量

notes: First observation in metrology_film_dielectric. A core-technology capability, not a named model specification. The category rests on the issuer’s own wording rather than inference: the technology is stated to achieve 三维结构中介质膜厚的高精度测量, and 介质 is dielectric. The aspect ratio is the structure the tool measures through, not what it measures, so this does NOT populate metrology_har: the measurand is film thickness. Printed as 深宽比大于 15:1, so a strict lower bound of 15 on a dimensionless ratio. The excerpt reproduces the page’s own consecutive text lines, joined with ¦ to mark each line break; the separator is editorial, because this filing lays out its benchmark and core-technology tables with labels split vertically around their value cells.

evidence.original_label: 高精度宽光谱椭偏聚焦技术 技术先进性 超薄膜厚测量重复性精度
evidence.excerpt: 该技术在椭偏膜厚测量的同时 ¦ 进行聚焦检测，实现聚焦和椭 该技术通过高精度的宽光谱椭偏测量 ¦ 高精度宽 ¦ 偏膜厚测量的功能一体化，通 技术和宽光谱波段下测量光斑的形状 ¦ 9 光谱椭偏 ¦ 过在椭偏膜厚测量位置的定位 尺寸控制技术，实现了超薄膜厚测量 ¦ 聚焦技术 ¦ 和聚焦，实现高精度的宽光谱 0.003nm 的重复性精度 ¦ 椭偏膜厚测量

notes: A core-technology capability for ultra-thin film thickness measurement by broadband spectroscopic ellipsometry, and the finest repeatability figure in the corpus. Deliberately held at the metrology parent rather than metrology_film_dielectric: this passage says only 超薄膜厚测量 without naming the film type, whereas the separate high-aspect-ratio technology on p134 does say 介质膜厚. Inferring dielectric here from the neighbouring technology would be a chained inference the source does not support.
